page_title: FRO 1-3 NAP | Frosinone v Napoli 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Matteo Marcenaro has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) trips an opposition player and Matteo Marcenaro signals a foul.
90+4' The game is interrupted. Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' Stanislav Lobotka will be replaced by Leo Ostigard (Napoli).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
88' Referee Matteo Marcenaro halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Rudi Garcia, then shows him a yellow.
86' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) replacing Abdou Harroui.
86' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

85' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The ball is out of play and Napoli manage to earn a corner.
83' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
81' Rudi Garcia decides to make a substitution. Victor Osimhen (Napoli) will be replaced by Giovanni Simeone.
79' 1 - 3 Fantastic team goal! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) was set free in the area by Giovanni Di Lorenzo and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
76' Substitution. Mathias Olivera will be replaced by Mario Rui (Napoli).
76' Substitution. Matteo Politano did his best and is replaced by Eljif Elmas (Napoli).
75' Substitution. Luigi Canotto (Frosinone) in, Jaime Baez Stabile out.
75' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) replaces Luca Mazzitelli.
73' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
72' Gennaro Borrelli (Frosinone) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
68' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
67' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Giuseppe Caso is replaced by Giorgi Kvernadze (Frosinone).
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marvin Cuni will be replaced by Gennaro Borrelli (Frosinone).
63' Frosinone can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

59' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Victor Osimhen (Napoli), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
57' OFF THE POST! Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) produces a thunderbolt of a strike from distance, but his effort rattles the left post!

56' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for an infringement. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Frosinone.
54' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
52' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul after Victor Osimhen (Napoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
49' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' Rudi Garcia has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Frank Anguissa comes on the pitch for Jens Cajuste (Napoli).
46' The whistle blows and Matteo Marcenaro starts the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
45+5' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
45+5' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
45+4' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle. Matteo Politano (Napoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
42' 1 - 2 Giovanni Di Lorenzo plays a neat ball into the path of Victor Osimhen (Napoli), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the crossbar! 1:2.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mathias Olivera (Napoli) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
37' The goal by Napoli is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
37' Wait! Referee Matteo Marcenaro has indicated he is going to review the Napoli goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
35' Goal! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.

33' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
31' Matteo Marcenaro has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone).
29' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
27' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
27' The corner from Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) is hurriedly cleared.
27' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
26' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Corner kick. Napoli will have an opportunity.
24' 1 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Matteo Politano (Napoli) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
22' Juan Jesus (Napoli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Frosinone comes to nothing.
19' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
16' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
15' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends the corner into the box, but Stefano Turati intercepts it and averts the threat.
13' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
12' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) for his blatant foul.
11' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Alex Meret no chance!
7' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
7' Referee Matteo Marcenaro is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Frosinone!
6' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Frosinone, he's going to review using VAR.
5' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marcenaro stops the game and makes a call. Frosinone are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
5' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
4' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
4' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Frosinone force a corner. They send men into the box.
3' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
2' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marcenaro saw the whole situation.
1' Flag up against Matteo Politano (Napoli). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
1' The first half has just begun.
Napoli will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Matteo Marcenaro.
